text:
anne: Heads-up — prepping airgap shrinkwrap for private/vpc release v2.3.0. Packaging window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need signoff on release notes, cosign keys, and decision re: legacy-installer deprecation flag.
pradeep: Noted. Is the installer image pinning final? We had a last-minute bump to ubuntu-min-base:20.04 -> 22.04.
olga: Yes, pin is in the manifest: `installer: redwood/installer:v2.3.0-22.04` — checksum verified. uploaded to staging mirror.
mike: CI found one flaky integration in onprem kube-proxy step — failing TLS handshake test intermittently. Trying a fix now.
infra-ci: deploybot: preflight checks started for v2.3.0-airgap
deploybot: preflight: manifest sha256=abc123...; shrinkwrap delta size=1.8GB; estimated transfer time to escort nodes ~18m.
pradeep: Important — can we avoid repack? The customer export process depends on stable filenames. If we repack, we need to bump the epoch.
anne: If we repack we must increment the epoch. Prefer to patch the kube-proxy test with a retry instead of repack.
mike: I pushed a transient retry to the test. Rerunning in CI.
release-manager: @anne @pradeep what's the plan for the legacy-installer deprecation flag? We had opt-in removal for v2.4 but some enterprise customers still rely on v1 path.
anne: Decision: keep legacy flag for this release but mark as DEPRECATED in release notes and add migration steps. We'll remove in v2.4.
pradeep: OK. I'll draft release notes and include migration steps + checksums.
olga: Signer schedule: cosign key rotation planned next Tuesday; ensure we sign now before rotation. I can sign after CI green.
deploybot: preflight: ci-status=running; signing=queued
mike: CI is green on integration after retry. ready for packaging.
release-manager: Great. Schedule: packaging start 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC. Canary to 3 escort nodes immediate after pack.
anne: Also set rollback criteria: if canary fails >5% requests with 5xx for 15m -> auto rollback to previous bundle v2.2.9 and open pager.
infra-ci: deploybot: packaging started
deploybot: packaging: creating shrinkwrap tarball, output=private-vpc-v2.3.0-shrinkwrap.tar.gz
pradeep: Added release notes draft to the docs PR: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/v2.3.0
olga: Signed artifact uploaded to mirror; cosign sig=cosign-ohno... check.
deploybot: packaging complete; artifact_sha=def456...; upload URL s3://redwood-releases/private/vpc/v2.3.0/shrinkwrap.tar.gz
anne: Can we stagger escort transfer to avoid saturating our offsite carriers? Set parallelism=2 per escort.
deploybot: transfer started to escorts [escort-eu-1, escort-us-2] with parallelism=2
mike: Observability: enabled extra tracing on canary routes for 30m. Adding temporary dashboard.
release-manager: After canary success, create release tag and chart PR to prod. Also send release notes email to customers - include deprecation warning.
pradeep: One more: include checksums file and a small verification script snippet in notes:
``
sha256sum shrinkwrap.tar.gz > shrinkwrap.sha256
curl -sS https://mirror/sha | sha256sum -c -
``
anne: ✅ All set here. Thanks team. I'll be on-call during the window.
infra-ci: deploybot: canary success threshold met; rollout to remaining escorts started
deploybot: rollout complete; status=success; final_artifact=def456
release-manager: Tagging and publishing release notes now. Shipping.
mike: Follow-up: file a post-release issue to remove legacy flag in v2.4 and track customers on opt-in list.
anne: Filed: https://redwood.internal/issue/RELEASES-842
pradeep: Closing thread, congrats :tada:
